reference.rule: exclusions(); rejection-transfer-v2 released answers; language-coverage and language-expansion partitions (priors and passages); all LLCT and HisCat documents; ReM prose outside the ungraded challenge pool; every language-expansion document; historical prose and verse; every >=8-word string of the evaluator-only files

selection_rule: Works fixed before any run by date, genre and length, never by model score; no substitution. Each work is normalized (language_coverage_sources.normalize_source: accents removed, j->i, k->c, w->uu, letters a-z only) and cut into 80-word chunks (chunks()). A chunk is removed if any 8-word shingle of it, with the 7-word tail of the previous kept chunk, is in R (every earlier train, calibration, challenge and released text) or occurs in any other selected work (whole text, all languages). The passage is the first 5200 letters of the kept chunks (exact_take: spaces removed, last chunk trimmed); rows keep the whole chunks used. Occitan passages 5-6 are second passages of BmT-2884 and Français_13504 starting at least 50000 kept letters after the end of the last chunk of their first passage, filtered again against the first passage. A selected work that cannot yield the letters stops the build.
